description.value: Brock Centre Liquor Store is an independent liquor retailer in Kamloops' Brock neighbourhood, operating at the same location since 2003. The renovated 2,500+ sq ft store features a large walk-in cooler stocked with cold beer, ciders, and coolers, plus a selection of over 200 wines and 174 hard spirits. A unique 'Pick a Beer' bulk option lets shoppers build their own package sizes, and the store carries local Kamloops and BC craft beers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, website all match). The about page confirms the store has been operating since 2003 at the same location and describes a retail liquor store selling cold beer, wine, spirits, ciders, and coolers. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, so those criteria remain null.
concerns: OSM address field omits unit number (unit 1); website and OSM addr:unit tag both show '1 - 1800 Tranquille Rd' — minor discrepancy in formatted address only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate retail beverage stop that touring cyclists could use for cold drinks and local craft beer, fitting the Food & Drink category. However, none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence, so a human reviewer should assess whether it meets the minimum threshold for directory inclusion.
